verdict.rationale: The evidence pack focuses entirely on GitLab's native CI/CD, security scanning, and general REST/OpenAPI automation, none of which document integrating with external CI/CD systems (e.g., Jenkins, CircleCI, TravisCI) as an alternative to GitLab's own pipelines. In fact, community evidence (gitlab-comm-10) reports that many third-party CI providers 'generally don't integrate with GitLab,' reinforcing the absence of this capability.
